description: MCP server for Google Search Console: properties, sitemaps, search analytics and URL inspection
name: io.github.ni-c/google-search-console-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Service account key as JSON, or base64-encoded JSON. One of the three credential options.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a service account key file. Alternative to GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client id. Use together with GSC_CLIENT_SECRET and GSC_REFRESH_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client secret. All three OAuth2 variables are required together.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 refresh token. All three OAuth2 variables are required together.
environmentVariables.name: GSC_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Path to application default credentials, used when no GSC_ credential is set.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS

environmentVariables.description: Default property, e.g. sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/ — makes site_url optional
environmentVariables.name: GSC_SITE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated properties this server may touch; anything else is refused
environmentVariables.name: GSC_ALLOWED_SITES

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (default: false)
environmentVariables.name: GSC_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to register; 'essential' selects a curated preset (default: all tools)
environmentVariables.name: GSC_ALLOW_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names or list_* prefixes to remove from whatever the allow list left
environmentVariables.name: GSC_DENY_TOOLS

title: Google Search Console
